title: Title, Registration and Sales Tax on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Title office rule — Vehicle Purchase Agreements.**

A title application is filed only for a deal in delivered or closed status, as the deal's record shows. The store files the buyer's title and registration application within the deal type's title filing days, in calendar days after the delivery date.

Title, registration and sales tax are collected at the exact amounts the state assesses. They are posted as the title and registration fee and as sales tax, with no store markup. Any difference found when the state assesses is posted or reversed for the exact difference.

| Situation | Treatment |
|---|---|
| deal reserved or contracted | no title application filed yet |
| deal delivered or closed | title application may be filed |
| state assesses more than was collected | the exact difference is posted |
| state assesses less than was collected | the exact difference is reversed |

*Hypothetical:* 412.60 was collected for title and registration and the state assesses 398.35. A reversal of 14.25 is made.
